findings.summary: DdOwnerSource.discover re-reads the admission record for card/generation/state, satisfying the spec's re-verification requirement. The card_entity_id fallback path issues a second control_plane.get() call when awaiting.card_entity_id is absent; this is correct but couples discovery correctness to the control plane exposing card_entity_id on the full record. Not a defect: resolver._stale_reason independently re-verifies the card against the decision payload, so a missing or wrong card degrades to a terminal no-op rather than a wrong resume.
